title: City Swimming Pool
text:
CITY SWIMMING POOL

Opening hours:
Monday – Friday: 6 a.m. – 10 p.m.
Saturday and Sunday: 8 a.m. – 8 p.m.

Tickets: adults £5, children (under 12) £3.

Children under 8 must swim with an adult.
Please have a shower before you swim.
No food or drinks near the pool.
You can buy a towel at the reception for £2.

Swimming lessons for children every Saturday at 10 a.m. Ask at the reception!

exercises.prompt: The pool opens at 6 a.m. on Sunday.
exercises.explanation: W weekend basen jest otwarty od 8 a.m.

exercises.prompt: A ticket for a 10-year-old child is £3.
You can eat near the pool.
exercises.explanation: „No food or drinks near the pool.”

exercises.prompt: There is a café at the pool.
exercises.explanation: Ogłoszenie nie mówi nic o kawiarni.
